releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.2 adds safe Headline Remote self-healing. Service 0.2.5.1 reads the authoritative Mesh Agent registry NodeId, consumes trusted MeshCentral presence signals from the Monitor API, starts a stopped MeshAgent automatically, and only restarts a running agent after three confirmed offline observations. Recovery is limited to three attempts in 30 minutes with persisted lockout and maintenance pause protection. Tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
